entries.notes: All 15 TypeScript declarations are translated: six source-map matrix cases, five pickup-watchdog cases, three warmup cases, and one interleaved task-local run-tracking case. The Rust suite preserves transient status retries, 500 ms exponential polling capped at 5 s, short-budget sleep clamping, stalled-probe cancellation and infra-event attribution, and per-test isolation. WF-RUST-095 requires the total warmup deadline to include probe creation and bounded cancellation, eliminating a late-probe status read after expiry. WF-RUST-096 replaces whole-URL substring matching with exact hostname classification so remote lookalikes cannot select local-only behavior. Final GREEN must exercise the real Rust runtime, timers, cancellation, infra recorder, and task-local state; scripted observations are insufficient.
